title: Added missing indexes for GP historical snapshot
summary: Added missing indexes to three GP historical snapshot staging tables to improve query performance during data migration.
key_points: New index on CUSTNMBR, APTODCTY, APTODCNM added to GP RM20201 and GP RM30201
New index on IVDOCTYP, DOCNUMBR, LNSEQNBR added to GPIVSerialLotNumberHist
Only key definitions added; no logic changes
Affects HybridGP historical snapshot staging tables
quote: This PR adds missing indexes to the following GP historical snapshot related staging tables.
